userMessage:
SDLC Dashboard start page for the Agentic SDLC model-driven app (PowerStudios Customer Portal): six KPI tiles (open stories, delivered autonomously %, avg autonomous lead time vs human path, awaiting a human, released this week, in progress), each opening a story view.
Pipeline strip with story counts per status (New to Released, plus Routed to human and Closed), and a breakdown of stories by type and by delivery path as simple bar charts.
Live Agent Activity feed (latest 15, auto refresh every 30 s, agent and outcome tint badges, click opens the story) and the last 5 releases with date, story count and deployment link. Fluent UI v9 per Skills/page-style.md.
